summary: Elevate your customer service approach with our comprehensive training course. Focus on retention strategies that ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty.
lede: Customer retention training covers ways to understand client journeys, measure service experience, and identify signs of churn. It is designed for customer experience, success, retention, and service operations professionals who need to reduce attrition and improve service delivery. Participants practice journey mapping, NPS, CSAT and CES measurement, Voice of the Customer analysis, RFM and CLV calculations, churn-risk analysis, service recovery planning, and executive reporting.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive program is tailored for professionals tasked with managing client lifecycles, reducing attrition, and optimizing service delivery operations.
modules: Customer Journey Mapping and Touchpoint Analysis
Voice of the Customer (VoC) and Sentiment Analysis
Predictive Churn Analytics and RFM Modeling
CX Strategy Integration and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of basic customer service principles and general business operations. Familiarity with CRM platforms (such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zendesk) and basic data analysis concepts is highly recommended. No advanced programming or statistical modeling experience is required, as all analytical frameworks will be taught using accessible spreadsheet tools and standard CRM reporting interfaces.
